item.title: Inside world's top science society's convention bashing Trump, pushing DEI, pronouns: 'Felt like a funeral'
item.description: A major scientific society's conference draw sharp criticism for its progressive messaging and vocal criticism of President Donald Trump.

item.title: Air Force One scraps iconic Kennedy-era paint scheme for Trump-approved red, white, blue design
item.description: Air Force One will get a new red, white and dark blue paint scheme as President Trump replaces the light blue design that defined presidential aircraft for over 60 years.

item.title: Major Trump critic has 'not dismissed' another presidential run ahead of 2028 election
item.description: New Jersey Democratic Sen. Cory Booker said on a podcast Tuesday that he has "not dismissed" the idea of launching another presidential campaign in 2028.

item.title: Mike Lee calls Schumer's 'Jim Crow 2.0' attack on voter ID bill 'paranoid fantasy'
item.description: Senate Democrats compare GOP voter ID push to "Jim Crow 2.0," but Sen. Mike Lee calls the comparison "paranoid fantasy" as the debate intensifies over federal election requirements.

item.title: Former NBA player Enes Kanter Freedom calls Eileen Gu 'a traitor' for representing China at Olympics
item.description: Former NBA player Enes Kanter Freedom accused Olympic skier Eileen Gu of betraying America by competing for China, citing human rights abuses and Gu's $23 million earnings.

item.title: Ethan Hawke warns against looking to 'jet-lagged, drunk' actors for political wisdom
item.description: Ethan Hawke warned during a film festival in Germany that the opinions of entertainers are valid, in that they are people like anybody else, but not the first source to go to.

item.title: Jimmy Kimmel to host Los Angeles fundraiser for House Democrats: report
item.description: ABC's Jimmy Kimmel will reportedly headline a massive Los Angeles fundraiser for House Democrats next month with ticket prices costing up to $300,000.

item.title: NYC Board of Elections worker says 'not my job to report anyone' when asked about registering non-citizens
item.description: A New York City election worker told an undercover reporter he would not report non-citizens trying to register to vote, saying "that's not my job."
